policy: Use the highest tier supported by fresh observed evidence. Lower-tier evidence never proves a higher tier, and unavailable native or packaged checks remain NOT RUN.

tiers.name: source-reviewed
tiers.required_evidence: Source, requirements, schemas, links or documented procedures inspected.
tiers.does_not_establish: Executable behavior, GIS-host integration or numerical output correctness.

tiers.name: offline-verified
tiers.required_evidence: Repeatable offline or static checks using deterministic fixtures, including expected results and executed commands.
tiers.does_not_establish: Loading or execution in ArcGIS, QGIS, a live provider, a real database service or another named native host.

tiers.name: native-integrated
tiers.required_evidence: A named compatible native GIS client, engine, database or live-provider adapter loads or integrates the feature with a controlled fixture.
tiers.does_not_establish: Complete end-to-end user workflow, independently reread production output or clean-machine packaging.

tiers.name: operation-verified
tiers.required_evidence: A real GIS, database or provider operation completes in the target runtime and its output is independently reopened or reread and compared with expected results.
tiers.does_not_establish: Clean-environment installation, upgrade, uninstall or packaged distribution behavior.

tiers.name: packaged-accepted
tiers.required_evidence: The packaged deliverable is installed or provisioned in a clean representative environment and the user workflow, persistence, export/reopen, recovery and uninstall or teardown checks are observed where applicable.
tiers.does_not_establish: Future provider uptime, unrestricted licensing or compatibility with untested versions and devices.
